title: Setting Out
notes: A self-portrait in the mirror, camera raised. Setting out: to go somewhere beautiful, to take photographs, to keep a record, and to love this world.
lens: Tamron 25-200mm F/2.8-5.6 Di III VXD G2
alt: The photographer, in a brown zip-neck sweater with a backpack strap over one shoulder, holds a Sony camera up to the face in front of a mirror, the lens hiding the eyes; tiled walls, sinks and racks of hanging clothes stretch away behind.
caption: Setting Out
